text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport 2.High school academic transcript 3.High school graduate certificate 4.Photocopy English Proficiency Certificate or medium-of-instruction certificate. 5.Personal Statement Write a personal statement (minimum 800 words) in Chinese or English, which should include a self-introduction, a description of your educational experience, your motivations for studying inChina, and your study plan. 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form 7. Statement of Financial Support certifying that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation and living expenses. It should be accompanied by an employment certificate or income certificate and a photocopy of the valid passport of the financial sponsor.
